6	import Mathlib
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtSheaf
8	import AlgebraicJacobian.RiemannRoch.CurveBaseChange
9	
10	/-!
11	# The cross-base identification for `picEt` — input 2 of the repaired descent route
12	
13	This file addresses `AJC.picrep.etale-rep.crossbase`, the input that
14	`review-ajc` measured (`I-1076`) as missing from every site that prices the
15	repaired representability route, and as *upstream* of the Galois step rather
16	than beside it.
17	
18	## What obligation this is
19	
20	The seam sorry `fgaPicardRepresentability`
21	(`Picard/FGAPicRepresentability.lean`) is discharged, on the committed
22	Milne–Kollár route, by descending `PicScheme.picEt` from a separably closed
23	extension. The descent needs the `k'`-scheme produced over `k'` to represent
24	`picEt` **of the base-changed curve** `C_{k'}`. What the construction actually
25	hands you is `picEt` **of the `k`-curve `C`, restricted to `k'`-tests**. Those
26	are *a priori* different functors on `(Sch/k')`, and if they are not
27	identified there is no functor for a Galois descent datum to be a datum *for* —
28	a mismatch no green build would reveal, since both sides typecheck.
29	
30	So the obligation is: for finite separable `k'/k` and a `k'`-test `T`,
31	
32	```
33	picEt (C_{k'})  ≅  (Over.map φ).op ⋙ picEt C          (φ : Spec k' ⟶ Spec k)
34	```
35	
36	as functors on `(Sch/k')ᵒᵖ`.
37	
38	## What this file proves, and what it does not
39	
40	**The whole sheafification layer of the obligation is FREE**, and that is the
41	result here. `picEt` is a *categorical* sheafification, and Mathlib's
42	`Functor.pushforwardContinuousSheafificationCompatibility` says sheafification
43	commutes with restriction along a continuous functor. Restriction along
44	`Over.map φ` *is* continuous for the two localised étale topologies (by
45	synthesis — `§1`), so the sheaf-level identification reduces, with no residue,
46	to the same statement one level down at the *unsheafified* relative Picard
47	presheaf (`§5`). That reduction is the content: it converts a statement about
48	an object defined by a universal property into a statement about an explicit
49	quotient of line-bundle classes.
50	
51	**The presheaf-level face is CLOSED too, so the identification is proved
52	outright** (`picEt_crossBaseIso`, `§6`) — this file has no `sorry`. Its four
53	layers:
54	
55	* the two total spaces are canonically isomorphic (`§2`, `crossBaseTotalIso`),
56	  by the single Mathlib lemma `pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso`;
57	* the `H_T`-coset *relation* transports across that iso in **both** directions,
58	  with the **same** coset witness `N` (`§3`, `crossBase_relPicRel` and
59	  `crossBase_relPicRel_inv`) — this is the layer where the two subgroups being
60	  quotiented by have to correspond, and it is the substantive one;
61	* hence the two relative Picard groups are in canonical **bijection** for every
62	  test (`crossBaseQuotEquiv`): the round trips reduce, through
63	  `relPicRel_of_iso`, to `crossBaseTotalIso`'s own `hom_inv_id`/`inv_hom_id`.
64	  It is additive (`crossBaseQuotMap_add`) because addition is descended tensor
65	  and pullback preserves tensor products of locally trivial bundles;
66	* and it is **natural in the test** (`crossBaseQuotMap_relFunctorial`), which is
67	  what upgrades the family of bijections to an isomorphism of functors — the
68	  distinction that matters, since `§5`'s reduction consumes an `Iso`, not a
69	  family of `Equiv`s. Naturality reduces to
70	  `pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_naturality`, which holds in **any** category with
71	  pullbacks: no geometry, no field, no curve.
72	
73	**Nothing here closes the seam sorry, and no antecedent of
74	`fgaPicardRepresentability` is witnessed for any curve by this file** — that
75	distinction is the point of the round's bar. What is closed is one *input of the
76	route*, in full and unconditionally; what remains open is the seam obligation
77	itself. The route's other inputs are the descent test
78	(`Picard/EtaleFieldCover.lean`, landed), `G1`/`G2` (whose single remaining gate
79	is `HasGaloisQuotient`), and — below all three — a section over separably closed
80	fields, which `I-1135` measured as having no producer in this project at all.
81	So the repair has **four** inputs, not three, and this file closes one of them.
82	
83	## Why not port the sibling project's version
84	
85	`Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild` proves a cross-base comparison as a
86	`MulEquiv` (`picEtCrossBaseEquiv`, `Picard/PicEtCrossBase.lean:316`, 468
87	lines). It is **not importable and not transcribable**: that project's `picEt`
88	is a hand-built limit of plus-classes over affine opens, this one's is a
89	categorical sheafification, and there is no `lake` edge between the projects.
90	Most of its length is a section-ring scalar tower which — as `review-ajc`
91	predicted, and as the outcome here confirms — a sheafification-based `picEt`
92	does not need: the sheafification layer is discharged by a Mathlib compatibility
93	iso instead. The 468 lines were a design lead, and the lead was that they are
94	not the seam. **For the record: 700 lines here, of which the great majority is
95	docstring** — the proof terms themselves are short, because each layer lands on
96	a Mathlib lemma. Reading the sibling as a lead rather than transcribing it was
97	worth more than the 468 lines would have been.
98	
99	## Measurement discipline
100	
101	Every synthesis claim below was checked with `lake build` first (oleans fresh,
102	EXIT=0, 8865 jobs) — a stale-import environment reports every probe as
103	succeeding (`I-1057`). The continuity claim of `§1` carries a control: the
104	strictly stronger `IsDenseSubsite` at the *same* two topologies does **not**
105	synthesize, so the pushforward is not an equivalence and the compatibility iso
106	of `§5` is not a triviality.
107	-/
108	
109	universe u
110	
111	open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry Limits
112	
113	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
114	
115	namespace Scheme
116	
117	namespace PicScheme
118	
119	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {k' : Type u} [Field k'] [Algebra k k']
120	
121	/-! ## §1. The restriction functor on tests, and its continuity -/
122	
123	/-- The structural morphism `Spec k' ⟶ Spec k` of a field extension. -/
124	noncomputable abbrev specMapAlgebra (k : Type u) [Field k] (k' : Type u) [Field k']
125	    [Algebra k k'] : Spec (CommRingCat.of k') ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) :=
126	  Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))
127	
128	/-- **Restriction of tests along `k ⊆ k'`**: a `k'`-scheme `T` is in particular
129	a `k`-scheme, via `T ⟶ Spec k' ⟶ Spec k`. This is the functor along which the
130	descent step compares the two Picard functors. -/
131	noncomputable abbrev restrictTest (k : Type u) [Field k] (k' : Type u) [Field k']
132	    [Algebra k k'] : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k')) ⥤ Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
133	  Over.map (specMapAlgebra k k')
134	
135	/-- `restrictTest` acts as the identity on the underlying scheme of a test. -/
136	@[simp]
137	theorem restrictTest_obj_left (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k'))) :
138	    ((restrictTest k k').obj T).left = T.left := rfl
139	
140	/-- `restrictTest` composes the structure morphism with `φ`, by definition. -/
141	@[simp]
142	theorem restrictTest_obj_hom (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k'))) :
143	    ((restrictTest k k').obj T).hom = T.hom ≫ specMapAlgebra k k' := rfl
144	
145	/-- **Restriction of tests is continuous** for the two localised étale
146	topologies `etaleTopologyOver k'` and `etaleTopologyOver k`.
147	
148	This is Mathlib's general instance for `Over.map` between localisations of one
149	topology (`GrothendieckTopology.over`), and it is what makes the sheafification
150	layer of the cross-base identification free — see `picEt_crossBaseIso_of_relPresheaf`.
151	
152	**Not a triviality**: the strictly stronger `IsDenseSubsite` at the same two
153	topologies does *not* synthesize (measured, control for this claim), so the
154	induced pushforward on sheaves is not an equivalence. -/
155	instance restrictTest_isContinuous :
156	    (restrictTest k k').IsContinuous
157	      (etaleTopologyOver k') (etaleTopologyOver k) :=
158	  inferInstance
159	
160	/-! ## §2. The geometric heart: cancellation of the intermediate base -/
161	
162	/-- **The two total spaces agree.** For a `k'`-test `T`, the curve base-changed
163	to `k'` and then producted with `T` over `k'` is the same scheme as the
164	original `k`-curve producted with `T` over `k`:
165	
166	```
167	C_{k'} ×_{Spec k'} T  ≅  C ×_{Spec k} T
168	```
169	
170	This is the geometric content of the cross-base identification, and it is a
171	single Mathlib lemma: `baseChangeField C k'` is by definition the pullback of
172	`C.hom` along `φ`, so this is base-cancellation
173	(`pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso`) for the composite `T.hom ≫ φ`.
174	
175	Note the right-hand side is literally the product formed by the *restricted*
176	test: `((restrictTest k k').obj T).hom` is `T.hom ≫ φ` by definition
177	(`restrictTest_obj_hom`), so this iso compares exactly the two schemes whose
178	Picard groups the two sides of the obligation take. -/
179	noncomputable def crossBaseTotalIso (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
180	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k'))) :
181	    pullback (baseChangeField C k').hom T.hom
182	      ≅ pullback C.hom ((restrictTest k k').obj T).hom :=
183	  pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso C.hom (specMapAlgebra k k') T.hom
184	
185	/-- The cancellation iso is compatible with the projection to the test: both
186	sides' second projections are the map to `T.left`. -/
187	@[simp]
188	theorem crossBaseTotalIso_hom_snd (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
189	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k'))) :
190	    (crossBaseTotalIso C T).hom ≫ pullback.snd C.hom ((restrictTest k k').obj T).hom

/-- **The étale-sheafified relative Picard functor** `Pic_{(C/k)ét}`
(Kleiman §2 Def. `df:Pfs`, étale-sheaf clause).

`T ↦ Pic(C ×_k T)/π_T^* Pic(T)` (`PicSharp.relPresheaf`), as a bundled object
of `Sheaf (etaleTopologyOver k) AddCommGrpCat`. Its sheaf property is not an
assumption but part of the datum — `Sheaf.cond`, extracted as
`etaleSheaf_isSheaf` below — which is the whole point of passing to it: the
unsheafified `relPresheaf` is not a sheaf even Zariski-locally.

This is a genuine instantiation of the parametric `PicSharp.etSheaf` of
`Picard/RelPicFunctor.lean` at the canonical étale topology, with one
correction: `etSheaf` sheafifies the *absolute* functor `PicSharp.presheaf`
(`T ↦ Pic(C ×_k T)`), whereas Kleiman's `Pic_{(C/k)ét}` and the
representability theorem are about the *relative* one, `relPresheaf`. It is
the relative functor that is sheafified here.

The abelian-group structure survives sheafification because the target
`AddCommGrpCat` has the sheafification adjunction
(`HasWeakSheafify` for a concrete, filtered-colimit-preserving forgetful
functor); `toEtaleSheaf` below is the unit. -/
noncomputable def etaleSheaf {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] :
    Sheaf (etaleTopologyOver k) AddCommGrpCat.{u+1} :=
  (CategoryTheory.presheafToSheaf (etaleTopologyOver k) AddCommGrpCat.{u+1}).obj
    (PicSharp.relPresheaf C)

/-- **The sheaf property of `Pic_{(C/k)ét}`, as a standalone statement.**

The underlying presheaf of `PicSharp.etaleSheaf C` satisfies the sheaf axiom
for the étale topology on `(Sch/k)`. This is `Sheaf.cond` of the bundled
object, stated separately because it is the property consumers cite: a
representing scheme for `Pic_{(C/k)ét}` exists only because the functor being
represented is an étale sheaf (a representable functor is a sheaf for any
subcanonical topology, so a non-sheaf can never be representable — which is
exactly why the unsheafified `relPresheaf` needs a rational point).

Proved, not assumed: sheafification produces a sheaf. -/
theorem etaleSheaf_isSheaf {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (etaleTopologyOver k) (etaleSheaf C).obj :=
  (etaleSheaf C).property

/-- **The comparison map** `Pic_{C/k} ⟶ Pic_{(C/k)ét}`, i.e. the unit of the
sheafification adjunction at the relative Picard presheaf.

Kleiman §2 Thm. 2.5 (`th:comp`) says this map is an isomorphism when `C` has a
`k`-rational point (and `O_S = f_* O_X` universally, automatic here). Over an
arbitrary base field it is only a comparison: the honest object is the target,
which is why the representability obligation is stated there. -/
noncomputable def toEtaleSheaf {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] :
    PicSharp.relPresheaf C ⟶ (etaleSheaf C).obj :=
  CategoryTheory.toSheafify (etaleTopologyOver k) (PicSharp.relPresheaf C)

/-- The universal property of the sheafification, in the form consumers use:
every morphism from the relative Picard presheaf to (the underlying presheaf
of) an étale sheaf factors uniquely through `toEtaleSheaf`.

This is what makes `Pic_{(C/k)ét}` the *canonical* choice rather than one
sheaf among many, and it is the step that turns a representing scheme for the
sheaf into a universal receiver of relative Picard classes. -/
noncomputable def etaleSheafHomEquiv {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    (G : Sheaf (etaleTopologyOver k) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    (etaleSheaf C ⟶ G) ≃ (PicSharp.relPresheaf C ⟶ G.obj) :=
  ((CategoryTheory.sheafificationAdjunction (etaleTopologyOver k)
    AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).homEquiv (PicSharp.relPresheaf C) G)

`relPicSetoid` on `LineBundle.OnProduct πC πT`, together with the abelian-group instance
`PicSharp.addCommGroup_via_tensorObj` on it.

**Relation (multiplicative form).** For `L L' : OnProduct πC πT` set
```
L ~ L'   ↔   ∃ N locally trivial on T,  L.carrier ≅ π_T^* N ⊗ L'.carrier,
```
where `π_T^* N = (LineBundle.pullbackAlongProjection πC πT N hN).carrier`. This is the left-coset
relation of `H_T := im π_T^*`. It is **equivalent** to the blueprint's `L ⊗ L'^{-1} ≅ π_T^* N`
(tensor both sides by `L'` / its inverse), but the multiplicative form avoids naming the tensor
inverse of `L'` in the *definition* — only the setoid-symmetry step consumes a tensor inverse (of
`N` on the base `T`, via `Modules.exists_tensorObj_inverse`). The blueprint statements
`lem:relpic_setoid_{refl,symm,trans}`, `lem:relpic_add_welldef` and `lem:pullback_inverse_iso`
are realized below in that multiplicative form. -/

/-- **The `H_T`-coset relation on `OnProduct πC πT`** (relative Picard, multiplicative form):
`L ~ L' ↔ ∃ N loc-triv on T, L.carrier ≅ π_T^* N ⊗ L'.carrier`. It encodes the
quotient `Pic(C ×_S T) / π_T^* Pic(T)` of `lem:rel_pic_sharp_groupoid`, and is coarser than the
absolute iso-class relation `RelPicPresheaf.preimage_subgroup`. -/
def relPicRel {S C T : Scheme.{u}} (πC : C ⟶ S) (πT : T ⟶ S)
    (L L' : LineBundle.OnProduct πC πT) : Prop :=
  ∃ (N : T.Modules) (hN : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial N),
    Nonempty (L.carrier ≅
      Modules.tensorObj (LineBundle.pullbackAlongProjection πC πT N hN).carrier L'.carrier)

/-- An isomorphism of the underlying bundles implies the `H_T`-coset relation (take `N = 𝒪_T`):
the relative relation is coarser than the absolute iso-class relation. Used to
transport the abelian-group axioms from the absolute iso-class group. -/
theorem relPicRel_of_iso {S C T : Scheme.{u}} {πC : C ⟶ S} {πT : T ⟶ S}
    {L L' : LineBundle.OnProduct πC πT} (e : Nonempty (L.carrier ≅ L'.carrier)) :
    relPicRel πC πT L L' := by

  refine ⟨SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf, isLocallyTrivial_unit, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  exact e ≪≫ (Modules.tensorObj_left_unitor L'.carrier).symm ≪≫
    Modules.tensorObjIsoOfIso (Modules.pullbackUnitIso (Limits.pullback.snd πC πT)).symm
      (Iso.refl L'.carrier)

/-- **Reflexivity of the `H_T`-relation** (blueprint `lem:relpic_setoid_refl`): `L ~ L`, witnessed
by `N = 𝒪_T` and the pullback–unit iso `π_T^* 𝒪_T ≅ 𝒪_{C×T}` plus the left unitor. -/
theorem relPicRel_refl {S C T : Scheme.{u}} (πC : C ⟶ S) (πT : T ⟶ S)

theorem relPicRel_symm {S C T : Scheme.{u}} {πC : C ⟶ S} {πT : T ⟶ S}
    {L L' : LineBundle.OnProduct πC πT} (h : relPicRel πC πT L L') :

  refine ⟨Ninv, hNinv, ⟨?_⟩⟩

    (M := (LineBundle.pullbackAlongProjection πC πT Ninv hNinv).carrier)
    (N := (LineBundle.pullbackAlongProjection πC πT N hN).carrier) (P := L'.carrier)).symm ≪≫ ?_

    (Iso.refl L'.carrier) ≪≫ ?_

    (Iso.refl L'.carrier) ≪≫ Modules.tensorObj_left_unitor L'.carrier

    (N := (LineBundle.pullbackAlongProjection πC πT N' hN').carrier) (P := L''.carrier)).symm ≪≫ ?_

    (Modules.pullbackTensorIsoOfLocallyTrivial (Limits.pullback.snd πC πT) N N' hN hN').symm

def relPicSetoid {S C T : Scheme.{u}} (πC : C ⟶ S) (πT : T ⟶ S) :
